title: Guided Help
section: Permanent Account Number (PAN) is a ten-digit alphanumeric number, issued in the form of a laminated card or e-PAN, by the Income Tax Department.[see more](javaScript:openDocumentViewer\('Others',%20'articleKey',%20'7277116'\)) How to apply for PAN?  An online application can be made through the website of UTIITSL or Protean eGov (formerly NSDL eGov) <https://www.pan.utiitsl.com/> <https://tinpan.proteantech.in/services/pan/pan-index> **Through PAN Application Center** - Application for PAN can be submitted at the PAN Application center of UTIITSL or Protean eGov <https://psaonline.utiitsl.com/PanPSACenters/forms/applicationCenters> <https://tinpan.proteantech.in/Facilitation-center> Forms  For New PAN Application _i._ [FORM No. 93](https://www.incometaxindia.gov.in/documents/d/guest/form-93)- For Individuals (Indian Citizen, NRI & RNOR) _ii._ [FORM No. 94](https://www.incometaxindia.gov.in/documents/d/guest/form-94) - Non-Individual Indian Entities  _iii._ [FORM No. 95](https://www.incometaxindia.gov.in/documents/d/guest/form-95) - For Individuals (Not a Citizen of India)  _iv._ [FORM No. 96](https://www.incometaxindia.gov.in/documents/d/guest/form-96) - Non-Individual Foreign Entities For Changes/Correction in PAN _i._ [PAN CR-01](https://www.incometaxindia.gov.in/documents/d/guest/pan-cr-01-individual) - For Individual _ii._ [PAN CR-02](https://www.incometaxindia.gov.in/documents/d/guest/pan-cr-02-non-individual) - For Non-individual Document Required for PAN Application  Document Required for PAN Application -[see more](https://www.incometaxindia.gov.in/documents/d/guest/annex-g-document-table) Track Status of PAN  **Track Status of PAN**   * [Protean (formerly NSDL eGov)](https://tin.tin.proteantech.in/pantan/StatusTrack.html)   * [UTITSL](https://www.trackpan.utiitsl.com/PANONLINE/#forward)  Verify PAN Status  **Verify PAN Status** By using the Online PAN Verification facility, one can know/verify the Permanent Account Number (PAN). .. [see more](https://eportal.incometax.gov.in/iec/foservices/#/pre-login/verifyYourPAN) Know Your Assessing Officer  Know Your Assessing Officer [see more](https://eportal.incometax.gov.in/iec/foservices/#/pre-login/knowYourAO) FAQs  **1. What is PAN?** **2. Who should apply for PAN?** **3. How is PAN different from TAN?** Ans: Below Forms are prescribed for PAN Application: _i._ Form 93: Individual (Citizen of India) _ii._ Form 94: Non-Individual Indian Entities _iii._ Form 95: Individual (Not a Citizen of India) _iv._ Form 96: Non-Individual Foreign Entities _v._ Form CR-01: Change or Correction in PAN Data (Individual ) _vi._ Form CR-02: Change or Correction in PAN Data (Non Individual) **5. How can an applicant apply for PAN?** Ans: Applications can be submitted online by accessing the portals of UTIITSL/Protean eGov or visiting PAN centres of authorized PAN Service Provider i.e. UTIITSL or Protean eGov. Domestic Companies/LLPs and FPIs can apply through Common Application Form (CAF) of MCA and SEBI respectively. **6. What are the supporting documents required for applying PAN?** Ans: The following supporting documents are required for PAN Application as per Rule 158 of Income Tax rule, 2026: _i._ Proof of Identity _ii._ Proof of Address _iii._ Proof of Date of Birth/Date of Incorporation. **7. Can any person other than applicant apply for PAN on behalf of applicant?**
